breakdown.description: The setup describes a vertical bubble column with gas injected to rise along the Y-axis, but gravity is applied horizontally, which would push the bubbles sideways instead of upwards.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt had gravity set to (-9.81 0 0), which applies gravity in the X-direction (horizontal). The generated specification corrected this to (0 -9.81 0), which applies gravity in the negative Y-direction (vertical, downward), matching the ground truth and consistent with a vertical bubble column where bubbles rise along the Y-axis.
